_about: Condition variants and tempting wrong products for the inorganic hidden-products questions (redesign plan 2026-11-25, inorganic kind 1). Standard textbook (NCERT) chemistry written by Claude on 2026-11-25 at the author's request (no approval step); nothing here comes from JEE questions. Each variant becomes a reaction the draw may use (core/pipeline/inorg_products.variant_edges); the blind product check (GPT-6 Luna) still names every drawn product before anything is paid for, so a wrong entry costs a redraw, never a wrong key. 'naive' is the product a student who ignores the printed condition writes: it is never printed, only used to compute the trap answer. 'naive_for_graph_edges' attaches such a wrong product to an existing graph edge.

options.conditions: Xe : F₂ = 1 : 5, 873 K, 7 bar, Ni vessel
Xe : F₂ = 1 : 20, 573 K, 60-70 bar, Ni vessel
excess NH₃, air bubbled through, charcoal

options.why_ask: books write it [Cr(OH)4]- or NaCrO2 too: only Cr(III)'s magnetism is the same in every form (live run hp_1)

options.why: Cr(VI) is reduced by the NH₄⁺ in the same salt
conc. HNO₃ takes iodine to +5 (iodic acid), not +7
H₂SO₄ protonates HNO₃, which loses water to give the nitronium ion

two_products_contain_the_element._about: graph edges where two products contain the named element (disproportionation), so 'the product containing X' has no single answer (live run hp_5): never used in hidden products

print_reagents_for_graph_edges._about: graph edges whose reagents list alternatives, printed as if all were added (live run hp_4): the one set printed instead

Mn2+_to_MnO4-_nabio.why: the strong oxidant takes Mn to +7

not_for_hidden_products._about: Graph edges kept for other question kinds but never drawn as a hidden-products row: the blind product check disputes the product and the reviewer approved keeping them out (graph audit 2026-11-26, tools/audit_inorg_products.py, outputs/audit_inorg_products.json).
not_for_hidden_products.CCl4_to_COCl2_ccl: superheated steam: COCl2 or complete hydrolysis to CO2 (checker CO2)
not_for_hidden_products.H2O2_to_H2O_ho: H2O2 + O3: H2O and O2 both contain O
not_for_hidden_products.NaNO2_to_NO2_nano: NaNO2 + HCl: NO2, NO or NOCl depending on conditions
not_for_hidden_products.SF4_to_H2SO3_sf: SF4 + H2O: SO2 or H2SO3 (geometry differs: bent vs pyramidal)
not_for_hidden_products.Cu2S_to_Cu2O_cus: partial roasting: Cu2O, or Cu after self-reduction
not_for_hidden_products.P4O10_to_H3PO4_po: amount of water not stated (H3PO4 vs HPO3); replaced by cv_p4o10_h2o (excess water)
